text: {"defects": ["The final 'Total' amount (US$199.50) in the 'Your order' summary has very low contrast (light grey text on a light grey background), making it hard to read.", "The line total for 'Ceramic Coffee Mug X 2' shows US$14.00 instead of US$28.00, so the displayed item totals (14.00 + 42.50 + 129.00 = 185.50) do not add up to the Sub-total of US$199.50.", "In the credit card input box, the 'Card number', 'MM / YY', and 'CVC' fields are improperly spaced and aligned, with 'Card number' touching the left border and 'MM / YY' and 'CVC' clustered in the middle."]}

defects: The final 'Total' amount (US$199.50) in the 'Your order' summary has very low contrast (light grey text on a light grey background), making it hard to read.
The line total for 'Ceramic Coffee Mug X 2' shows US$14.00 instead of US$28.00, so the displayed item totals (14.00 + 42.50 + 129.00 = 185.50) do not add up to the Sub-total of US$199.50.

In the credit card input box, the 'Card number', 'MM / YY', and 'CVC' fields are improperly spaced and aligned, with 'Card number' touching the left border and 'MM / YY' and 'CVC' clustered in the middle.
